headings.title: Elements of concealing an offense
headings.reviewNote: Defines concealing an offense by conferring or accepting consideration to conceal an offense or withhold evidence.

headings.title: Classification as misdemeanor or class E felony
headings.reviewNote: Classifies concealing an offense as a class A misdemeanor, elevated to a class E felony when concealing a felony.

headings.title: Elements of hindering prosecution
headings.reviewNote: Defines hindering prosecution by harboring, warning, assisting, or obstructing apprehension of an offender.

headings.title: Classification as misdemeanor or class E felony
headings.reviewNote: Designates hindering prosecution as a class A misdemeanor, elevated to a class E felony if the underlying conduct is a felony.

headings.title: Elements of perjury in official proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Defines perjury as knowingly testifying falsely to a material fact under oath with purpose to deceive in an official proceeding.

headings.title: Definition of material fact
headings.reviewNote: Defines a material fact as one that could substantially affect or did affect the course or outcome of the proceeding.

headings.title: Irrelevance of knowledge of materiality and excluded defenses
headings.reviewNote: Precludes defenses based on mistaken belief in immateriality or general lack of competence to testify.

headings.title: Defense of retraction during same official proceeding
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a defense when the person retracts the false statement in the same proceeding before its falsity is exposed.

headings.title: Defendant burden of injecting retraction defense
headings.reviewNote: Places the burden of injecting the issue of retraction upon the defendant.

headings.title: Classification as class E felony for nonfelony proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Designates perjury committed in a proceeding not involving a felony charge as a class E felony.

headings.title: Felony classifications for perjury in felony proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Classifies perjury in felony proceedings as class D, B, or A felony depending on whether committed to convict of felony or murder.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 7 subsections verbatim against archived text (effective 1-01-17).

headings.title: Elements of making a false affidavit
headings.reviewNote: Defines making a false affidavit as swearing falsely to a material fact with purpose to mislead.

headings.title: Application of statutory materiality rules
headings.reviewNote: Applies the materiality definition and defense exclusions of section 575.040 to false affidavit prosecutions.

headings.title: Defense of retraction by affidavit or testimony
headings.reviewNote: Establishes defense for retracting the false statement by affidavit or testimony unless made after exposure or substantial reliance by any person.

headings.title: Defendant burden of injecting retraction defense
headings.reviewNote: Places the burden of injecting the issue of retraction under subsection 3 upon the defendant.

headings.title: Classification as class C or class A misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Classifies making a false affidavit as a class C misdemeanor, or class A misdemeanor if done to mislead a public servant in performing official duty.

entries.reviewSummary: Rewrote shifted/fabricated subsections 3-5 to match archived text (retraction defense, defendant burden of injection, and class C/class A misdemeanor penalties).

headings.title: Elements of making a false declaration
headings.reviewNote: Defines making a false declaration by submitting a misleading false statement accompanied by statutory notice to a public servant.

headings.title: Application of statutory materiality rules
headings.reviewNote: Applies materiality standards and defense exclusions from section 575.040 to false declaration prosecutions.

headings.title: Defense of retraction before exposure or reliance
headings.reviewNote: Establishes defense for retracting the false statement or item unless made after exposure or substantial reliance by the public servant.

headings.title: Defendant burden of injecting retraction defense
headings.reviewNote: Places the burden of injecting the issue of retraction under subsection 3 upon the defendant.

headings.title: Definition of written to include approved electronic filings
headings.reviewNote: Defines written to include filings submitted in an electronic or other format or medium approved or prescribed by the secretary of state.

headings.title: Classification as class B misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Classifies making a false declaration as a class B misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Rewrote shifted/fabricated subsections 3-6 to match archived text (retraction defense, defendant burden of injection, electronic 'written' definition, and class B misdemeanor).

headings.title: Elements of making a false report
headings.reviewNote: Defines making a false report by knowingly communicating false reports of crimes, emergencies, or catastrophes to authorities.

headings.title: Defense of retraction before substantial reliance
headings.reviewNote: Establishes defense for retracting the false statement or report before the law enforcement officer or any other person took substantial action in reliance.

headings.title: Defendant burden of injecting retraction defense
headings.reviewNote: Places the burden of injecting the issue of retraction under subsection 2 upon the defendant.

headings.title: Classification as class B misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Classifies making a false report as a class B misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Rewrote shifted/fabricated subsections 2-4 to match archived text (retraction defense, defendant burden of injection, and class B misdemeanor).

headings.title: Elements of making a false bomb report
headings.reviewNote: Defines making a false bomb report by knowingly communicating false reports of explosive devices or bombs.

headings.title: Classification as class E felony
headings.reviewNote: Classifies making a false bomb report as a class E felony.

entries.reviewSummary: Corrected subsection 2 heading and note from class D felony to statutory class E felony.

headings.title: Elements of tampering with a judicial officer
headings.reviewNote: Defines tampering with a judicial officer by threats, harm, coercion, harassment, or doxxing personal information.

headings.title: Definition of judicial officer
headings.reviewNote: Defines judicial officer to include judges, commissioners, arbitrators, special masters, juvenile officers, prosecutors, and referees.

headings.title: Definition of judicial officer's family
headings.reviewNote: Defines a judicial officer's family to include spouses, descendants, ancestors, and stepchildren.

headings.title: Classification as class D felony
headings.reviewNote: Designates the offense of tampering with a judicial officer as a class D felony.

headings.title: Classification as class B felony for bodily injury
headings.reviewNote: Elevates tampering with a judicial officer to a class B felony if the violation results in death or bodily injury.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections verbatim against archived text (2023 amendment; formerly 565.084).

headings.title: Elements of tampering with physical evidence
headings.reviewNote: Defines tampering with physical evidence by altering, destroying, concealing, or presenting false records or objects.

headings.title: Classification as misdemeanor or class E felony
headings.reviewNote: Classifies offense as a class A misdemeanor, elevated to a class E felony if obstructing felony proceedings.

headings.title: Elements of tampering with a public record
headings.reviewNote: Defines tampering with a public record by knowingly making false entries, altering, destroying, or concealing public records.

headings.title: Classification as class A misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Designates the offense of tampering with a public record as a class A misdemeanor.

headings.title: Elements of false impersonation
headings.reviewNote: Defines false impersonation by pretending to be a public servant or licensed professional, or giving another's identifying factors to an officer upon arrest.

headings.title: Amendment and expungement of records discovered before conviction
headings.reviewNote: Requires prosecutor notification and court amendment and expungement of false identifying factors in arrest and court records when subdivision (3) violation is discovered before conviction.

headings.title: Prosecutor motion to correct and expunge records after conviction
headings.reviewNote: Requires prosecutor motion and court order amending and expunging false identifying factors in arrest and court records when subdivision (3) violation is discovered after conviction.

headings.title: Victim motion for expungement and correction under section 610.123
headings.reviewNote: Permits victims of false impersonation in arrest or conviction records to move for expungement and correction under section 610.123.

headings.title: Classification as class B or class A misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Classifies false impersonation as a class B misdemeanor, or class A misdemeanor if representing oneself as a law enforcement officer.

entries.reviewSummary: Rewrote fabricated subsections 2-5 to match archived text (pre-conviction and post-conviction record amendment/expungement, victim motion under section 610.123, and class B/class A misdemeanor penalty).

headings.title: Elements of simulating legal process
headings.reviewNote: Defines simulating legal process by delivering or issuing documents designed to simulate court summonses or legal process.

headings.title: Exemption for subpoena properly issued by notary public
headings.reviewNote: Exempts a subpoena properly issued by a notary public from this section.

headings.title: Classification as class B misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Classifies simulating legal process as a class B misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Rewrote shifted/fabricated subsections 2-3 to match archived text (notary public subpoena exemption and class B misdemeanor).

headings.title: Elements of filing a nonconsensual common law lien
headings.reviewNote: Defines filing a nonconsensual common law lien against real or personal assets not authorized by statute, consent/contract, or court imposition.

headings.title: Exemption for filing officers acting within official scope
headings.reviewNote: Exempts filing officers from section liability when acting within the official scope of their employment.

headings.title: Tiered misdemeanor and felony penalties for repeat offenses
headings.reviewNote: Classifies offense as class B misdemeanor (first), class A (second), or class E felony (third+), with third+ conviction designating persistent offender under section 558.016.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified against archived text (2025 H.B. 495); tightened subsection 1 heading to offense elements and added persistent-offender designation in subsection 3 note.

headings.title: Duty to stop on signal and obey directions
headings.reviewNote: Imposes duty on vehicle operators and animal riders to stop on signal and obey directions of law enforcement officers or firefighters.

headings.title: Classification as class A misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Designates willful failure or refusal to obey officer or firefighter signals as a class A misdemeanor.

headings.title: Elements of resisting or interfering with arrest
headings.reviewNote: Defines resisting or interfering with arrest, detention, or stop by force, violence, physical interference, or flight.

headings.title: Application to warrant and warrantless arrests and stops
headings.reviewNote: Applies section provisions to arrests, stops, and detentions for offenses, infractions, ordinances, or parole warrants.

headings.title: Presumption of fleeing vehicle stop upon emergency signal
headings.reviewNote: Creates statutory presumption of flight if driver continues operating vehicle after emergency lights or siren are activated.

headings.title: Unlawful arrest defense exclusion and civil remedies preservation
headings.reviewNote: Excludes unlawful arrest as a criminal defense while preserving defendant's right to bring civil actions for unlawful arrest.

headings.title: Classification as misdemeanor or class E felony
headings.reviewNote: Designates offense as class A misdemeanor, elevated to class E felony for felony arrests or flight creating risk of injury.

headings.title: Impoundment and forfeiture of vehicles used in flight
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes impoundment and forfeiture of vehicles used in violations punished as class E felonies.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 6 subsections against archived text (2025 H.B. 495; permissive vehicle impoundment/forfeiture in subsection 6) and 2019 State v. Shaw annotation.

headings.title: Citation as Valentine's Law
headings.reviewNote: Designates section 575.151 as Valentine's Law.

headings.title: Elements of aggravated fleeing a motor vehicle stop
headings.reviewNote: Defines aggravated fleeing a vehicle stop involving high speed creating substantial risk, physical injury, or death.

headings.title: Presumption of fleeing vehicle stop upon emergency lights
headings.reviewNote: Establishes presumption of fleeing if driver continues operating vehicle after seeing emergency lights or hearing sirens.

headings.title: Unlawful arrest defense exclusion and civil remedies preservation
headings.reviewNote: Precludes defenses based on unlawful stop or lack of knowledge of stop basis while preserving civil remedies.

headings.title: Tiered felony penalties based on injury or death
headings.reviewNote: Classifies aggravated fleeing as class D felony (with mandatory one year served), class B felony for injury, or class A felony for death.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections verbatim against archived text (Valentine's Law, L. 2024 S.B. 754).

headings.title: Elements of disarming peace officer or correctional officer
headings.reviewNote: Defines disarming an officer by removing or depriving an officer of firearms, deadly weapons, or less-lethal devices.

headings.title: Exceptions for lack of knowledge or felonious conduct
headings.reviewNote: Exempts individuals who reasonably did not know person was an officer or where officer was engaged in felonious conduct.

headings.title: Classification as class D felony
headings.reviewNote: Designates the offense of disarming a peace officer or correctional officer as a class D felony.

headings.title: Elements of endangering corrections employee with bodily fluids
headings.reviewNote: Defines endangering corrections employees or facility visitors by intentionally causing contact with bodily fluids.

headings.title: Definitions of statutory terms
headings.reviewNote: Defines corrections employee, offender, prisoner, and serious infectious or communicable disease.

headings.title: Classification as misdemeanor, class E, or class D felony
headings.reviewNote: Classifies offense as class E felony, class A misdemeanor if substance is unidentified, or class D felony for knowingly exposing another to a transmissible serious infectious disease.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified against archived text (formerly 565.085); fixed subsection 2 defined-terms note and added class A misdemeanor for unidentified substance to subsection 3 heading and note.

headings.title: Elements of endangering mental health employees or visitors
headings.reviewNote: Defines endangering mental health employees or visitors at secure facilities by causing contact with bodily fluids.

headings.title: Definitions of statutory terms
headings.reviewNote: Defines department of mental health employee, offender, secure facility, and serious infectious or communicable disease.

headings.title: Classification as class E or class D felony
headings.reviewNote: Classifies offense as a class E felony, elevated to a class D felony if offender knowingly exposes another to serious disease.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified verbatim against archived text (2021 amendment; formerly 565.086).

headings.title: Elements of offense of aiding a sexual offender
headings.reviewNote: Defines aiding a sexual offender by withholding information, harboring, concealing, or providing false information to law enforcement.

headings.title: Inapplicability of section to incarcerated or detained offenders
headings.reviewNote: Exempts circumstances where the sexual offender is already incarcerated or held in custody in a correctional facility or jail.

headings.title: Classification as class E felony
headings.reviewNote: Designates the offense of aiding a sexual offender as a class E felony.

headings.title: Elements of interference with legal process
headings.reviewNote: Defines interference with legal process as interfering with or obstructing a person known to be authorized to serve process to prevent service.

headings.title: Definition of process excluding arrest warrants
headings.reviewNote: Defines process to include any writ, summons, subpoena, warrant other than an arrest warrant, or other court process or order.

headings.title: Classification as class B misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Classifies interference with legal process as a class B misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Rewrote shifted/fabricated subsections 2-3 to match archived text (definition of 'process' excluding arrest warrants, and class B misdemeanor) and removed unstated 'force or threats' from subsection 1 note.

headings.title: Elements of refusing to make employee available
headings.reviewNote: Defines offense of employer or business agent refusing to make employee available to officer serving process during work hours.

headings.title: Classification as class C misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Designates refusing to make an employee available for service of process as a class C misdemeanor.

headings.title: Elements of failure to execute an arrest warrant
headings.reviewNote: Defines failure to execute an arrest warrant by an officer purposely failing to execute process to allow a person to escape.

headings.title: Classification as misdemeanor or class E felony
headings.reviewNote: Classifies failure to execute an arrest warrant as a class A misdemeanor, elevated to a class E felony in felony cases.

headings.title: Affirmative defense of exigent circumstances for traffic misdemeanors
headings.reviewNote: Establishes affirmative defense of exigent circumstances when failing to execute warrants for certain traffic offenses.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified against archived text (2021 amendment) and 1989 State v. Wahby annotation.

headings.title: Elements of refusal to identify as a witness
headings.reviewNote: Defines offense of refusing to report or giving false report of name and address after witnessing an offense or serious incident.

headings.title: Classification as class C misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Designates refusal to identify as a witness as a class C misdemeanor.

headings.title: Elements of escape from commitment, detention, or release
headings.reviewNote: Defines escape from commitment, detention, or conditional release under mental health or sexually violent predator laws.

headings.title: Classification as class E felony
headings.reviewNote: Designates escape from mental health commitment or conditional release as a class E felony.

headings.title: Elements of escape or attempted escape from custody
headings.reviewNote: Defines escape or attempted escape while being held in custody following arrest for an offense or probation violation.

headings.title: Classification as misdemeanor or tiered felony
headings.reviewNote: Classifies escape from custody as class A misdemeanor, class E felony if arrested for felony, or class A felony if weapon or hostage used.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified verbatim against archived text (L. 2022 S.B. 799).

headings.title: Elements of tampering with electronic monitoring equipment
headings.reviewNote: Defines tampering with electronic monitoring equipment by intentionally removing, altering, damaging, or destroying court-ordered devices.

headings.title: Exemption for owner or agent performing equipment maintenance
headings.reviewNote: Exempts equipment owners and their authorized agents performing ordinary maintenance or repairs.

headings.title: Classification as class D felony
headings.reviewNote: Designates the offense of tampering with electronic monitoring equipment as a class D felony.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified verbatim against archived text (2021 merged amendment).

headings.title: Elements of violating condition of lifetime supervision
headings.reviewNote: Defines offense of knowingly violating a condition of court-ordered or parole board lifetime supervision.

headings.title: Classification as class D felony
headings.reviewNote: Designates violating a condition of lifetime supervision as a class D felony.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified verbatim against archived text (2021 merged amendment).

headings.title: Elements of escape or attempted escape from confinement
headings.reviewNote: Defines escape or attempted escape while held in confinement after arrest, conviction, or institutional treatment center placement.

headings.title: Classification as class B felony for corrections confinement
headings.reviewNote: Designates escape or attempted escape from confinement in the department of corrections as a class B felony.

headings.title: Penalties for escape from jail or local facility
headings.reviewNote: Classifies escape from jail as class E felony, class D felony if beating someone, or class A felony if deadly weapon or hostage used.

headings.title: Elements of failure to return to confinement
headings.reviewNote: Defines offense of purposely failing to return to confinement while on work release or temporary leave without guard.

headings.title: Exemption for persons on bail, probation, or parole
headings.reviewNote: Exempts persons free on bond, bail, or recognizance and persons on probation or parole from section application.

headings.title: Classification as misdemeanor or felony based on commitment
headings.reviewNote: Classifies failure to return as class C misdemeanor, class A misdemeanor for county jail felony sentence, or class E felony for state prison.

headings.title: Elements of aiding escape of a prisoner
headings.reviewNote: Defines aiding escape by introducing weapons or escape tools into confinement or assisting a prisoner escaping from custody.

headings.title: Classification as misdemeanor or class B felony
headings.reviewNote: Classifies aiding escape as class A misdemeanor, elevated to class B felony if weapon introduced or prisoner held on felony charge.

headings.title: Elements of permitting escape by public servant
headings.reviewNote: Defines permitting escape by public servant or jail employee knowingly allowing weapons into facility or permitting prisoner escape.

headings.title: Classification as class E or class B felony
headings.reviewNote: Designates permitting escape as a class E felony, elevated to a class B felony if permitting deadly weapons into confinement.

headings.title: Elements of disturbing a judicial proceeding
headings.reviewNote: Defines disturbing a judicial proceeding by disrupting proceedings through assembly, shouting, or placards to intimidate participants.

headings.title: Classification as class A misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Designates the offense of disturbing a judicial proceeding as a class A misdemeanor.

headings.title: Elements of tampering with a judicial proceeding
headings.reviewNote: Defines tampering with a judicial proceeding by threats, harassment, or benefits intended to influence official action of judge or juror.

headings.title: Classification as class D felony
headings.reviewNote: Designates the offense of tampering with a judicial proceeding as a class D felony.

headings.title: Elements of tampering with a witness or victim
headings.reviewNote: Defines tampering with a witness or victim by force, threats, benefits, or dissuading reports and prosecutions.

headings.title: Classification as misdemeanor or felony and parole restriction
headings.reviewNote: Classifies offense as class A misdemeanor, elevated to class D felony if original charge is felony, with parole ineligibility.

headings.title: Elements of acceding to corruption
headings.reviewNote: Defines acceding to corruption by judicial officer or witness knowingly soliciting or accepting benefits to influence action or testimony.

headings.title: Classification as felony or class A misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Classifies subdivision (1) judicial/juror/referee corruption as class C felony, subdivision (2) witness corruption in felony prosecution or to testify falsely as class D felony, and otherwise class A misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified against archived text (L. 2017 S.B. 34); clarified all judicial/juror/referee and false-testimony tiers in subsection 2 note.

headings.title: Elements of improper communication with juror or referee
headings.reviewNote: Defines improper communication by communicating with jurors, masters, or arbitrators outside proceedings to influence official action.

headings.title: Classification as class B misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Designates the offense of improper communication as a class B misdemeanor.

headings.title: Elements of misconduct by a juror
headings.reviewNote: Defines misconduct by a juror by promising a verdict prior to deliberation or receiving unauthorized evidence without court disclosure.

headings.title: Classification as class A misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Designates the offense of misconduct by a juror as a class A misdemeanor.

headings.title: Elements of misconduct in selecting or summoning juror
headings.reviewNote: Defines misconduct by public servants knowingly acting unfairly or partiality in selecting or summoning jurors.

headings.title: Classification as class B misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Designates misconduct in selecting or summoning a juror as a class B misdemeanor.

headings.title: Elements of misconduct in administration of justice
headings.reviewNote: Defines official misconduct in administration of justice by coerced confessions, illegal seizures, improper pleas, jail refusals, or ticket quotas.

headings.title: Classification as class A misdemeanor
headings.reviewNote: Designates misconduct in the administration of justice as a class A misdemeanor.

headings.title: Citation as Max's Law
headings.reviewNote: Designates section 575.353 as Max's Law.

headings.title: Elements of assault on a law enforcement animal
headings.reviewNote: Defines assault on a law enforcement animal by knowingly attempting to kill, disable, or cause serious physical injury.

headings.title: Classification as class A misdemeanor or tiered felony
headings.reviewNote: Classifies assault on a police animal as class A misdemeanor, class E felony if veterinary care required, or class D felony for death.
